checks.title: negative control: a registration made WITHOUT ctx.effect is detected as a leak (proves the checks can fail)
toy plugin registers a block, a layout, an exercise kind and a preset through typed registries
unload leaves nothing behind (registries, event listeners, timers)
duplicate registration fails the second plugin, rolls back its partial work, leaves the first intact
plugin waiting on a service stays inactive, activates when the service appears, and is torn down/re-activated when the service is removed/restored
restart / config update re-runs apply with no duplicate registrations and no leaked effects
async apply and async disposers: dispose() waits for them, in reverse registration order
Config schema (Standard Schema) rejects bad config and fails only that plugin
per-course scoping: ctx.isolate() gives each course its own lesson registry
plugin that throws in apply: FAILED state, message and plugin frame survive, process stays up, no unhandled rejection
events: emit/parallel/serial/bail/waterfall dispatch; listeners die with their plugin
plugin forms: function, object with apply, class, ES module namespace
concurrent load of 100 plugins, then concurrent dispose
churn: 2000 load/unload cycles of the toy plugin leave registries, fibers and heap flat
